Steve Jobs and Steve Wozniak found Apple.
Ponce de Leon reaches Florida.
Martin Cooper makes the first handheld mobile phone call.
Bill Gates and Paul Allen found Microsoft.
Dutch explorers reach Easter Island on Easter Sunday.
The first modern Olympic Games open in Athens.
The World Health Organization is founded.
Heike Kamerlingh Onnes discovers superconductivity.
Lee surrenders at Appomattox, ending the US Civil War.
The Titanic sets sail from Southampton.
Apollo 13 launches toward the Moon.
Yuri Gagarin becomes the first human in space.
Thomas Jefferson is born.
Noah Webster copyrights his American dictionary.
Leonardo da Vinci is born.
Harriet Quimby becomes the first woman to fly across the English Channel.
The crippled Apollo 13 returns its crew safely to Earth.
Yankee Stadium opens in New York.
Gordon Moore publishes the prediction now called Moore's law.
Pasteur and Bernard complete their first pasteurisation test.
The Red Baron is shot down over France.
The first Earth Day is celebrated.
William Shakespeare is traditionally said to have been born.
The Hubble Space Telescope is launched.
Watson and Crick publish the double-helix structure of DNA.
Ranger 4 becomes the first US craft to reach the Moon.
John Milton sells the rights to Paradise Lost for 10 pounds.
Thor Heyerdahl's raft Kon-Tiki sets sail across the Pacific.
Gideon Sundback patents the modern zip fastener.
George Washington is inaugurated as the first US president.
